title: Byzantine Robustness, Robust Aggregation & Poisoning Defense Execution Graph

flow: SimulationConfig ingested: validate mutual privacy-defense compatibility early (SecAgg / FHE vs non-linear defense conflict guards)
Local bank training loop: each bank trains local model on non-IID data partition
Adversarial attack injection (if enabled): AdversarialAttackInjector transforms designated attacker bank update (sign flip, scaled outlier, gaussian noise)
Byzantine defense filtering (if enabled): fl_engine.apply_byzantine_defense evaluates robust aggregation (Krum, Median, Trimmed Mean, Bulyan, Spectral)
Hardware-isolated aggregation (if enabled): TEEDriver.execute_secure_aggregation evaluates robust aggregation on plaintext weights inside enclave memory boundary
Parameter aggregation: FederatedLearningEngine.aggregate_parameters performs sanitized consensus update
Consortium evaluation & breakdown verification: MetricsService logs post-round global test metrics across all bank nodes
active_guards: Sanitization of non-finite (NaN/Inf) weights before aggregation

flow: Benchmark config creation: create_canonical_byzantine_config validates condition matrix hash integrity
Data loading & partitioning: DirichletNonIIDPartitioner generates isolated train/test sets across n nodes
Local client training: PyTorch CNN/MLP trains on local partition, computing model delta relative to global model
Attacker generation: BaseByzantineAttack.apply transforms honest delta into malicious delta without mutating honest copies
Zero-silent-fallback aggregation: benchmarks/byzantine/aggregators.py enforces exact mathematical preconditions (Krum: n >= 2f+3, Bulyan: n >= 4f+3, Trimmed Mean: 2k < n)
Evaluation & metric computation: evaluates global model on held-out test set, computing clean retention ratio and relative loss
active_guards: Strict precondition assertion (InvalidConfigurationError on n < 2f+3 or n < 4f+3)
Input validation: _validate_deltas raises ValueError on NaN, Inf, or empty delta lists
Attacker knowledge model enforcement (strict isolation from test set and other banks' private data)
